scope: Independent native host subagents reviewing runtime/source/installation within the documented trusted-local alpha scope; no human audit or model benchmark implied

reviews.summary: Reviewed the actual engine/store/council/config/workspace/runner contracts and architectural/security documentation for the documented trusted local-agent scope. The SQLite mutation model, task DAG, fail-closed atomic rounds and release checks are coherent. Previously reported disposition-replay is fixed: per-role context now binds authored findings, dispositions and history; individual submissions and atomic round completion validate the corresponding role context. Independent isolated temporary-project probes rejected both pre-finding and pre-resolution author packets, accepted a fresh post-resolution approval, retained acceptance of an unaffected role packet from the prior shared snapshot, and completed a subsequent atomic five-role round with distinct role contexts and a valid audit. Protocol approvals/check commands in these probes were explicit fixtures, not independent engineering judgments. Executed .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -q on the revised source: 63 tests passed in 5.465 seconds. No architectural correctness blockers remain identified in scope; no repository source was edited by this reviewer.

Reviewed the current runtime implementation, CLI/SDK integration, state transitions and regressions. The helper propagates its verified checkout/src through inherited PYTHONPATH, and a fresh-venv regression covers the complete path. Inspected the per-role authored-finding context integration and its replay regression. Independently ran .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: all 63 tests pass. No remaining reproducible blocker found within the documented trusted-local runtime scope.

Read the final engine, council coordination, role-specific packet context binding, checkout helper, fingerprint, test runner, persistence and regression tests. Observed PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests: 63 tests passed in 5.891s, including the fresh package-free venv subprocess-import regression. Independently reproduced debugger pre-objection approval replay after fixed disposition: rejected; fresh host approval accepted; an atomic round with distinct per-role finding contexts committed and audit verified. Earlier independent probes verified pending-round fail-closed readiness, overlapping-round replacement and stale-completion rejection, reopen/audit integrity, task-packet rejection, executable chmod invalidation, and correct fixture/subtest/direct-skip discovery counts. Originally reported defects and the later fixture-skip counting defect are fixed. No remaining reproducible debugging blockers found within review scope.

Renewed security review after inspecting current engine.py, council.py, standalone skill helper and changed regression/tool tests. Role-specific context digests now bind authored findings and disposition history; host imports and atomic round completion validate the appropriate role context, and release checks it. The pre-objection approval replay regression passes, including a subsequent fresh atomic round. The helper propagates its absolute adjacent checkout/src on PYTHONPATH; observed the package-free venv test run initialization and both default subprocess checks successfully with inherited PYTHONPATH removed. Independently ran PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: all 63 tests passed in 5.347 seconds. Previous review independently confirmed executable mode invalidates release, FIFO/oversized scanner input fails promptly and 50.21 MiB audit verification uses 0.412 MiB peak Python allocation. No remaining blocker found in the reviewed scope. Trusted commands/adapters, local database authors and the documented stopped-writer filesystem assumption remain explicit trust assumptions; this approval does not claim sandboxing or exhaustive security auditing.

Current-source product/release review passed. Verified checkout-helper-path is fixed in the primary skill; role-specific packet digest documentation now matches the renewed finding/disposition context behavior. Six tool/installer tests passed, including fresh uninstalled-venv helper default checks. Rebuilt wheel and sdist outside the repository; isolated installed runtime bytes matched current checkout. Ten renewed installed CLI steps passed: dependency-free reinstall, version, init/task/check with one executed unittest and security triage, own product packet/review import, report and correctly blocked release awaiting the other four role approvals. Earlier clean installation also verified skill copying, overwrite refusal and copied helper operation; distribution inspection verified py.typed, MIT license, skill/docs/examples in sdist and mutable state exclusion. Alpha limits and evidence claims are appropriately explicit. This approves local product publishability, not actual GitHub publication, which remains blocked by absent authenticated account. No remaining product findings.
